_readme: The Stacks catalogue: every anime, in the order they are listed here (that is the page's default sort).
Hand-edit this file, then run `python3 fetch_catalogue.py` to pull covers and metadata from AniList and rebuild stacks/index.html.

Fields: title (as shown), mal (MyAnimeList id, from the URL myanimelist.net/anime/<id>/...). Optional: status ("watching" | "caught up"), alltimer (true), manga (true: read the manga too), tag (short spine mark), take (one line, yours), quote, ref (where the quote is from).
